1943.title: The Red Lion
1943.text: Margaret Tuff, of the Red Lion Inn, Bridge, near Canterbury, gave notice she'd take the surname Smith. A landlady's name, in the paper.

1985.title: The Railway Inn
1985.text: The Railway Inn at Cefn Mawr, near Wrexham, was kept by innkeepers in partnership. Somebody pulled pints there that night.

2026.title: 2026 · the mill house at dusk
2026.text: Ajax and Shaz, married. One long table, stone and water, and every lamp lit one at a time until the only light in the place was people who chose to be there.
